_help.corner: where the needles should land: bottom_left, bottom_right, top_left, top_right, or center (pad centre)
_help.inset_um: distance of the needle (mark CENTRE) from both edges of `corner`, on the most constrained pad; the mark edge is about half a mark width (~7 um) closer to the pad edge
_help.max_aspect: a mark counts as round if long side / short side <= this; 2.0 tolerates pixel steps on ~14 um marks and still rejects scrub tails
_help.min_valid_fraction: fraction of pads that must have exactly one round mark clear of the edge; the others are left out and listed in rejected_pads
_help.max_spread_um: 95th percentile of the marks' distance from their median position: how consistently the needles land; above this the offset is refused
_help.chuck_sign_x: chuck X per image X: -1 = chuck +x moves the needle LEFT on the pad
_help.chuck_sign_y: chuck Y per image Y: +1 = chuck +y moves the needle DOWN on the pad
